author: shq1v
quote: GTA 6 is a disappointing game, filled with inappropriate and indecent scenes, offering no new or innovative storyline. Every installment repeats the same ideas, events, and mission structures without bringing anything truly new to the **** top of that, the game runs at just 30 FPS, while Rockstar exploits its fanbase through misleading practices and excessive pricing. Even worse, there is no physical disc release, depriving players of the option to own and keep a physical copy of the **** is disappointing to see a game receive so much hype despite its lack of innovation, while the company continues to demand more and more from its audience.
